WITH RECURSIVE all_dates AS (
    SELECT '2020-01-01'::DATE as date_val
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_val + INTERVAL '1 day'
    FROM all_dates
    WHERE date_val < '2020-04-28'::DATE
),
customer_txn AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date_dt,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            ELSE -txn_amount
        END as balance_change,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            ELSE -txn_amount
        END) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date_dt ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as running_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_txn_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date_dt,
        running_balance,
        LAG(running_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date_dt) as prev_balance,
        LAG(txn_date_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date_dt) as prev_txn_date
    FROM customer_txn
),
customer_min_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as min_txn_date,
        MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as max_txn_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        cmm.customer_id,
        ad.date_val as date_val,
        cmm.min_txn_date,
        cmm.max_txn_date
    FROM customer_min_max cmm
    CROSS JOIN all_dates ad
    WHERE ad.date_val >= cmm.min_txn_date AND ad.date_val <= cmm.max_txn_date
),
customer_txn_for_join AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date_dt,
        running_balance
    FROM customer_txn_with_prev
),
customer_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.customer_id,
        cd.date_val,
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT ct.running_balance 
             FROM customer_txn_for_join ct 
             WHERE ct.customer_id = cd.customer_id AND ct.txn_date_dt <= cd.date_val 
             ORDER BY ct.txn_date_dt DESC 
             LIMIT 1),
            0
        ) as daily_balance
    FROM customer_dates cd
),
customer_balance_zeroed AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_val,
        GREATEST(daily_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM customer_balance
),
customer_monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_val) as month,
        MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM customer_balance_zeroed
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_val)
),
monthly_total AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(max_daily_balance) as total_max_balance
    FROM customer_monthly_max
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_total ORDER BY month
